fromsong: A new song from this one
copyhint: Select the link below and copy it
app: Queue, radio, Remaster, crop and fades are in the Suno app only.
nplay: Listen draws Suno’s player in the chat; if it stays silent, open the song on suno.com.
mix_a: Tap song A — its music or its style.
mix_b: Now song B — its lyrics, or the second half of a mashup.
mix_ok: A and B are chosen. What to make:
mx_style: Style of A + lyrics of B
mx_cover: Cover of A with the lyrics of B
mx_note: Each opens the editor first; credits only after the card and your yes.
pl_add: Tap a playlist — the song goes into it.
ws_open: Tap one to open its songs.
ws_add: Tap a workspace — the song moves into it and leaves the one it was in.
pl_none: No playlists yet — name the first one below.
ws_none: No workspaces yet — name the first one below.
caption: Caption on suno.com
